title: Add 'o' keybinding to open external session tool
description: Add keybinding 'o' that exits Ralph and opens the configured adapter tool (claude or opencode) with the current session ID. The adapter type is already in config (props.adapter). The session ID is tracked in lastSessionId() signal. When pressed, Ralph exits completely and spawns the external tool with --resume flag.
acceptance: Pressing 'o' when session ID exists spawns external tool with correct session
Tool choice respects configured adapter (claude or opencode)
Ralph exits cleanly after spawning external tool
Pressing 'o' when no session ID exists does nothing (keybinding disabled)
technicalNotes: Add handler in useKeyboard block (ralph-app.tsx:349-376). Use Bun.spawn to launch external tool. Exit via existing handleQuit pattern but with different exitReason. Adapter name available from props.adapter type or can derive from CLIAdapter interface.

title: Show tooltip for 'o' command when available
description: Display '[o] open' hint in footer keybinding area when session ID exists. Follows existing pattern of '[e] expand [q] quit' hints in footer-panel.tsx:63. Only show when lastSessionId is defined (command is available).
acceptance: Footer shows '[o] open' hint when session ID exists
Hint hidden when no session ID yet
Matches existing hint styling ([e] expand [q] quit)
technicalNotes: FooterPanel receives lastSessionId as prop. Add conditional span after existing hints. Use same #666666 color as other hints.
outOfScope: Dynamic hint based on adapter name
